name: Daily Conversations
description: Từ vựng giao tiếp hằng ngày theo chủ đề: Shopping, Eating Out, Travel, Hotels, Airlines, Banking, Doctor, Pharmacy...

words.definition: to let someone or something
words.example: My insurance does not allow choosing my own hospital.

words.definition: that can be used instead of something else
words.example: Have you thought of an alternative plan?

words.definition: a particular part or feature of a situation, an idea, a problem
words.example: She felt she had looked at the problem from every aspect.

words.definition: a feeling of worry
words.example: Whenever I have health concerns, I call my doctor.

words.definition: to give special importance to something
words.example: The nurse emphasized the importance of eating a balanced diet.

words.definition: to become subject to
words.example: I incurred substantial expenses that my health plan does not cover.

words.definition: the people who work for an organization
words.example: The employee went to see the director of personnel about taking an extended leave of absence.

words.definition: a plan of action agreed or chosen by a political party, a business, etc.
words.example: The company's insurance policy did not cover cosmetic surgery.

words.definition: one part of something larger
words.example: A portion of my benefits is my health care coverage.

words.definition: paying no attention, even if the situation is bad or there are difficulties
words.example: Regardless of the cost, we all need health insurance.

words.definition: money that employees receive for doing their job
words.example: The technician was pleased to have a raise in salary after only six months on the job.

words.definition: to be convenient or useful for somebody
words.example: I have finally found a health plan that suits my needs.

words.definition: the reason why people make a particular choice
words.example: She was chosen for the job on the basis of her qualifications.

words.definition: to finish making or doing something
words.example: We ordered some dessert to complete our meal.

words.definition: to make someone feel very pleased, interested or enthusiastic
words.example: Exotic flavor always excite me.

words.definition: a substance added to food or drink to give it a particular flavour
words.example: The cook changed the flavor of the soup with a unique blend of herbs.

words.definition: to be unable to remember something
words.example: The waiter forgets bringing the rolls, annoying the customer.

words.definition: one of the things from which something is made, especially one of the foods
words.example: We want to make a special cake. To do that, we need to buy all the ingredients.

words.definition: to form an opinion about somebody / something
words.example: You shouldn’t judge someone by their appearance alone.

words.definition: a situation that is full of confusion, especially because somebody has made a mistake
words.example: There was a mix-up about the ingredients and the dish was ruined.

words.definition: a person who gives money and support to artists and writers
words.example: This restaurant has many loyal patrons.

words.definition: to say that something will happen in the future
words.example: He predicts that the trend will continue.

words.definition: done, without somebody deciding in advance what is going to happen, or without any regular pattern
words.example: We randomly made our selections from the menu.

words.definition: to help someone remember something
words.example: He is so hard-working that he has never been reminded of homework.

words.definition: something that you achieved
words.example: The attainment of his ambitions was still a dream.

words.definition: to come together to form a single thing or group
words.example: The director combined two previously separate visual techniques.

words.definition: happening without stopping
words.example: He continued to ignore everything I was saying.

words.definition: a piece of writing or speech that says what someone or something is like; the act of writing or saying in words what someone or something is like
words.example: This is the description of our new house.

words.definition: to move apart and go away in different directions
words.example: Police dispersed the protesters with tear gas.

words.definition: movies, music, etc. used to entertain people
words.example: There was not entertainment for children of guests at the hotel.

words.definition: a variety of things of a particular type
words.example: The range of the director's vision is impressive.

words.definition: to let someone or something come out of a place where they have been kept
words.example: She is trying to release her album as planned.

words.definition: the act of presenting someone or something in a particular way
words.example: The film's representation of world poverty through the character of the hungry child was quite moving.

words.definition: as a separate person or thing; not together
words.example: The theater was very crowded so we had to sit separately.

words.definition: following immediately one after the other
words.example: This was their fourth successive win.

words.definition: to attend to go, to manage
words.example: Ticket agents must courteously deal with irate customers.

words.definition: a place to which someone or something is going or being sent
words.example: The next destination is Ha Long bay.

words.definition: to recognize the difference between two people or things
words.example: We must distinguish between two kinds of holidays.

words.definition: to use less money, time, etc. than you normally use
words.example: My travel agent knows I like to economize and always looks out for the best prices for me.

words.definition: equal in value, amount, meaning, importance, etc.
words.example: The food the airline serves in business class is equivalent to that served in first class.

words.definition: a short trip made for pleasur
words.example: There are regular weekend excursions throughout the summer.

words.definition: the money that you spend on something
words.example: Buying a new house needs a lot of expense.

words.definition: to make something longer or larger
words.example: There are plans to extend the subway line in this city.

words.definition: expected to do something or to become something
words.example: I narrowed my list of prospective destinations to my three top choices.

words.definition: all the circumstances and things that are happening at a particular time and in a particular place
words.example: The airline suggested I check with the State Department regarding the political situation in the country I'm flying to.

words.definition: very much; a lot
words.example: The airline I work for had a substantially higher rating for customer satisfaction than our competitors had.

words.definition: an organized set of ideas or theories
words.example: The airline system covers the entire world with flights.

words.definition: to discuss prices, with somebody in order to reach an agreement that is acceptable
words.example: Lois compared the sweaters carefully to determine which was a better bargain.

words.definition: to be able to accept and deal with something unpleasant
words.example: Moya doesn't like crowds so she cannot bear shopping during the holiday rush.

words.definition: the way that somebody behaves, especially towards other people
words.example: Suspicious behaviour in a department store will draw the attention of the security guards.

words.definition: the place where you pay for the things that you are buying in a supermarket
words.example: The line at this checkout is too long, so let's look for another.

words.definition: the state of being physically relaxed or having a pleant life
words.example: I like to dress for comfort if I'm spending the day shopping.

words.definition: to become greater in size, number or importance
words.example: The telephone networks in rural areas should be expanded.

words.definition: to examine something completely or carefully to find out more about it
words.example: Reading history books is like exploring the past.

words.definition: one thing on a list of things to buy, do, talk about, etc
words.example: Do you think I can get all these items into one bag?

words.definition: required by law
words.example: The jewelry store has a mandatory policy of showing customers only one item at a time.

words.definition: goods that are bought or sold; goods that are for sale in a shop / store
words.example: I am very impressed with the selection of merchandise at this store.

words.definition: with a lot of control and rules that must be obeyed
words.example: Our store strictly enforces its return policy.

words.definition: a general diretion in which a situation is changing or developing
words.example: The youth try to keep up with the fashion trend.

words.definition: having the most modern and recently developed ideas, methods, etc.
words.example: Since the hotel installed an advanced computer system, all operations have been functioning more smoothly.

words.definition: a group of stores or hotels owned by the same company
words.example: Budget-priced hotel chains have made a huge impact in the industry.

words.definition: to state or show that something is definitely true or correct,
words.example: Please write to confirm your reservation.

words.definition: to think or believe that something will happen
words.example: She expects to see her new baby girl.

words.definition: a person, usually a woman, whose job is to manage the shopping, cooking, cleaning, etc. in a house or an institution
words.example: Eloise's first job at the hotel was as a housekeeper and now she is the manager.

words.definition: to formally or officially tell someone about something
words.example: They notified the hotel that they had been delayed in traffic and would be arriving late.

words.definition: to prevent something from happening or someone from doing something; to make something impossible
words.example: The horrible rainstorm precluded us from traveling any further.

words.definition: to repeat the exact words that another person has said or written
words.example: Can I quote you on that?

words.definition: a measurement of the speed at which something happens
words.example: The sign in the lobby lists the seasonal rates.

words.definition: an arrangement for a seat on a plane or train, a room in a hotel, etc. to be kept for you
words.example: I know I made a reservation for tonight, but the hotel staff has no record of it in the system.

words.definition: useful function
words.example: The food was good but the service was very slow.

words.definition: to say “yes” to an offer, invitation, etc.
words.example: She accepts the gift with a big smile, and thanks her boyfriend several times.

words.definition: to show that in an account the total money spent is equal to the total money received
words.example: It took him over an hour to balance his checkbook.

words.definition: to take and use something that belongs to someone else, and return it to them at a later time
words.example: Can I borrow your mobile phone for a while? I have lost mine on the train.

words.definition: being careful about what you say or do
words.example: Act cautiously when signing contracts and read them thoroughly first.

words.definition: to take away money, points, etc., from a total amount
words.example: By deducting the monthly fee from her checking account, Yi was able to make her account balance.

words.definition: an amount of the profits that a company pays to people who own shares in the company
words.example: The dividend was calculated and distributed to the group.

words.definition: an initial partial payment
words.example: By making a large down payment, the couple saved a great deal in mortgage interest.

words.definition: to give a bank, etc. the legal right to own your house, land, etc. if you do not pay the money back that you have borrowed from the bank to buy the house or land
words.example: Hiram mortgaged his home to get extra money to invest in his business.

words.definition: limited or small in size or amount
words.example: Access to the safe deposit box vault is restricted to key holders.

words.definition: your name as you usually write it, for example at the end of a letter
words.example: The customer's signature was kept on file for identification purposes.

words.definition: remove
words.example: When can I take money out of bank?

words.definition: a piece of business that is done between people, especially an act of buying or selling
words.example: Banking transaction will appear on your monthly statement.

words.definition: to go to someone for information or advice
words.example: If the pain continues, consult your doctor.

words.definition: the ability to make someone or something do what you want
words.example: His every action is controlled by the manager.

words.definition: useful, easy, or quick to do; not causing problems
words.example: Living here is so convenient – everything I need is just 5 minutes away.

words.definition: to discover something
words.example: The tests are designed to detect the disease early.

words.definition: one of several things that cause or influence something
words.example: The result will depend on a number of different factors.

words.definition: communicate with somebody, especially while you work, play or spend time with them
words.example: My pharmacist was concerned about the interaction of the two medications I was prescribed.

words.definition: a point at which something stops being possible or existing
words.example: We were reaching the limits of civilization.

words.definition: to watch and check something over a period of time
words.example: The patient had weekly appointments so that the doctor could monitor their progress.

words.definition: that can develop into something or be developed in the future
words.example: They will select potential matches and help the two people meet face to face.

words.definition: a small amount of a substance taken from a larger amount and tested in order to obtain information about the substance
words.example: It is necessary to give the students some samples.

words.definition: a feeling about something important
words.example: How many senses do you have?

words.definition: to offer to do something without being forced to do it
words.example: I've worked as a volunteer at a special school twice since I finished Grade 10.
